crossRefs.note: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to…
That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”
Yahweh appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself…

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
translations.bsb: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
translations.kjv: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
translations.asv: that Jehovah appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
